entries.beda9ca1e489dd71: It sets out as its slogan: “Aiming to make maximum use of its resources, improve manufacturing capabilities to establish unshakable cost competitiveness, create new product value, and further raise its corporate value as a contributor to resource recycling.” Under the “Godo Steel Group Medium-Term Vision 2030” from fiscal 2026, it adopts “Proactive×Challenge” as its action principle and aims to restore and improve earnings capacity and strengthen its financial position through growth investment, strengthened human capital investment and the promotion of sustainability, among other measures. Its revenue target is ¥225 billion.
entries.e59c35deb7ebebfb: In the Steel Business, the company manufactures and sells wire rods, various large and medium shaped steels, rails, structural steel bars, reinforcing steel bars, processed steel bar products, processed wire products and threaded deformed reinforcing bars, and in the Agricultural Materials Business it manufactures and sells organic fertilizers, chemical fertilizers and others.
entries.e5e9f669261b68c4: The Godo Steel Group is a business model that manufactures and sells steel products such as wire rods, shaped steel and bars, and agricultural materials such as fertilizers, and earns consideration from them.
entries.e72a9c53b2fb7ab8: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,051 million, down ¥3,271 million from ¥11,322 million in the previous consolidated fiscal year.
